title: PromptVersion - Data API
description: Represents an in-app guidance prompt or walkthrough. Available in API version 46.0 and later.

ActionButtonLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ActionButtonLabel.description: Label for the action button or link. Maximum of 25 characters. For a walkthrough, specify this value on the last step.

ActionButtonLink.description: URL for the action button or link. Maximum of 1,000 characters. You can’t use the GROUP BY option in a SOQL query for this field. For a walkthrough, specify this value on the last step.

Body.description: Body content. In API version 60.0 and later, enter up to 4,000 characters for all prompt types. In earlier API versions, enter up to 240 characters for floating prompts and targeted prompts. Enter up to 4,000 characters for docked prompts. For docked prompts, the maximum characters include HTML markup, not just readable text.

DelayDays.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DelayDays.description: Number of days between occurrences. For a walkthrough, specify this value on the first step.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

DismissButtonLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DismissButtonLabel.description: Label for the dismiss button of a floating or targeted prompt. Maximum of 15 characters.

DisplayPosition.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
DisplayPosition.description: The position of a floating prompt on the page. Valid values are: TopLeft TopCenter TopRight MiddleLeft MiddleCenter MiddleRight BottomLeft BottomCenter BottomRight

DisplayType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
DisplayType.description: The type of prompt. Valid values are: DockedComposer—A docked prompt FloatingPanel—A floating prompt Targeted—A targeted prompt. Available in API version 52.0 and later.

ElementRelativePosition.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ElementRelativePosition.description: The location of a targeted prompt relative to the element. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later. Valid values are: BottomCenter BottomLeft BottomRight LeftBottom LeftCenter LeftTop RightBottom RightCenter RightTop TopCenter TopLeft TopRight

EndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EndDate.description: The date to stop showing the in-app guidance. For a walkthrough, specify this value on the first step.

Experience.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Experience.description: This field corresponds to the Environment picklist in In-App Guidance Builder. Available in version 60.0 and later. Possible values are: Lightning—Default. The in-app guidance is used in a Lightning Experience app or page. Site—The in-app guidance is used in a supported Experience Cloud site page.

ExperienceContextId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExperienceContextId.description: Required if the value of Experience is Site. The ID of the Experience Cloud site context associated with the in-app guidance prompt. Available in version 60.0 and later. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

Header.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Header.description: Label for the header of a docked prompt. This value is the label contained in the window’s browser bar. Maximum of 36 characters.

ImageAltText.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ImageAltText.description: Indicates the alt text of an image. Required if ImageLocation or ImageID is specified.

ImageId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ImageId.description: The ID of the ContentAsset that holds the image. Required if ImageLocation or ImageAltText is specified. This is a relationship field.

ImageLocation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ImageLocation.description: Indicates the location of the image in relation to the body text. Required if ImageID or ImageAltText is specified. Valid values are: Top Bottom Right, which is for floating or targeted prompts only Left, which is for floating or targeted prompts only

IndexWithIsPublished.description: Used by Salesforce for efficient querying.

IndexWithoutIsPublished.description: Used by Salesforce for efficient querying.

IsPublished.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPublished.description: Indicates whether the in-app guidance is active (true) or not (false).

ParentId.description: ID of the in-app guidance. This is a relationship field.

PublishedByUserId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PublishedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who activated the in-app guidance. If the in-app guidance is part of a package, this value is the user who installed the package. This is a relationship field.

PublishedDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PublishedDate.description: Indicates the date the in-app guidance was activated. If installed from a package, this value is the date when the package was installed. For walkthroughs, this field can only be specified on the first step.

ReferenceElementContext.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the element that the targeted prompt is associated with. Available in API version 52.0 and later.

ShouldDisplayActionButton.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
ShouldDisplayActionButton.description: Indicates whether an action button or link is included (true) or not (false).

ShouldIgnoreGlobalDelay.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
ShouldIgnoreGlobalDelay.description: Indicates whether the in-app guidance ignores the global time delay and instead shows on page load (true) or not (false). This field is available in API version 48.0 and later.

StartDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StartDate.description: Indicates the date to start showing the in-app guidance. For a walkthrough, specify this value on the first step.In API version 48.0 and earlier, this field is required.

StepNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StepNumber.description: Required for walkthroughs only. Indicates the number of the last step the user viewed or interacted with in a walkthrough. Include up to 10 steps. Numbers must be consecutive without repeated or skipped numbers. Available in API version 49.0 and later.

TargetAppDeveloperName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetAppDeveloperName.description: The app’s developer name where the in-app guidance appears. Deprecated in API version 51.0 and later.

TargetAppNamespacePrefix.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetAppNamespacePrefix.description: The app’s namespace prefix where the in-app guidance appears. This value must match the target app’s NamespacePrefix in the org that the package is being installed into. Maximum of 15 characters. Deprecated in API version 51.0 and later.

TargetPageKey1.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetPageKey1.description: Used by Salesforce to identity the prompt’s page location along with targetPageKey2, targetPageKey3, targetPageKey4, and targetPageType.

TargetPageKey1Ref.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TargetPageKey1Ref.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the prompt’s page location along with TargetPageKey2, TargetPageKey3, TargetPageKey4, and TargetPageType.

TargetPageKey2.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetPageKey2.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the prompt’s page location along with TargetPageKey1, TargetPageKey3, TargetPageKey4, and TargetPageType.

TargetPageKey3.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetPageKey3.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the prompt’s page location along with TargetPageKey1, TargetPageKey2, TargetPageKey4, and TargetPageType.

TargetPageKey4.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetPageKey4.description: Used by Salesforce to identify the page location along with TargetPageKey1, TargetPageKey2, TargetPageKey3, and TargetPageType. This field is available in API version 53.0 and later.

TargetPageType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetPageType.description: The type of page where the in-app guidance appears.

TargetRecordType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetRecordType.description: Used by Salesforce to determine if in-app guidance is specific to a record type. This field is available in API version 53.0 and later.

ThemeColor.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ThemeColor.description: Indicates which custom theme color is applied to the in-app guidance. Required if ThemeSaturation is specified. For a walkthrough, specify this value on the first step. Valid values are: Theme1—derived from the current brand color Theme2—derived from the current page background color Theme3—derived from the current global header color Theme4—derived from the current app theme color

ThemeSaturation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ThemeSaturation.description: Indicates which color value, or saturation, is applied to the in-app guidance that has a custom theme color. Required if ThemeColor is specified. For a walkthrough, specify this value on the first step. Valid values are: Dark Light

TimesToDisplay.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TimesToDisplay.description: Required if recurrences are scheduled. The maximum number of times to show the in-app guidance. Salesforce detects whether the user interacts with the in-app guidance, then determines whether to show the in-app guidance again or cancel scheduled recurrences. Maximum value of 30. For a walkthrough, specify this value on the first step.

Title.description: The label for the title. Maximum of 36 characters.

UserAccess.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
UserAccess.description: Indicates which permissions can see the in-app guidance. Valid values are: Everyone, which indicates that there’s no permission restrictions SpecificPermissions, which indicates that only users with all the specific user permissions specified can see the in-app guidance In API version 48.0 and earlier, this field is required.

UserProfileAccess.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
UserProfileAccess.description: Indicates which profiles can see the in-app guidance. This field is available in API version 48.0 and later. Valid values are: Everyone, which indicates that there are no profile restrictions SpecificProfiles, which indicates that users with any of the specified user profiles can see the in-app guidance

VersionNumber.description: The number remains 1 since multiple versions aren’t saved in the org.

VideoLink.description: The embed URL for a video in a docked prompt. Maximum of 1,000 characters. You can specify this field or the image field, but not both. This field is available in API version 48.0 and later. See Considerations for Creating In-App Guidance.

special_access_rules: To add, edit, manage, and view prompts and walkthroughs in Lightning Experience or in Experience Cloud sites, see Considerations for Creating In-App Guidance and Permissions for Creating and Accessing In-App Guidance in Salesforce Help for permissions.
